archiveFailed.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner and Duplicate Scanner dialogs: error toast when some files could not be archived

selectedForArchival.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner and Duplicate Scanner dialogs: footer count of checked files
selectedForArchival.context: {count} is the number of selected files.

archiveSelected.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner and Duplicate Scanner dialogs: destructive button that archives the checked files
archiveSelected.context: Archive = hide from the library (reversible), not delete.

pdf.trigger.where: Library toolbar: tooltip of the heart-pulse icon button that opens the PDF Health Scanner

pdf.title.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: dialog title

pdf.description.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: dialog description

pdf.scanPrompt.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: text before scanning
pdf.scanPrompt.context: {count} is the number of PDF files in the library.

pdf.scanButton.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: button that starts the scan

pdf.allHealthy.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: heading when no problems were found

pdf.noIssues.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: line under the heading when no problems were found
pdf.noIssues.context: {count} is the number of files scanned.

pdf.issuesSummary.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: summary above the list of problem files
pdf.issuesSummary.context: {count} = problem files, {healthy} = number of healthy files.

pdf.statusCorrupt.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: problem type for a file whose PDF is damaged

pdf.statusFetchError.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: problem type for a file that could not be downloaded

pdf.issueWithError.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: problem line under a file name
pdf.issueWithError.context: {status} is the translated problem type (Corrupt / Fetch error); {error} is a technical error message, usually English.

pdf.archivedToast.where: Library > PDF Health Scanner dialog: success toast after archiving
pdf.archivedToast.context: {count} is the number of files archived.

dup.trigger.where: Library toolbar: tooltip of the icon button that opens the Duplicate Scanner

dup.title.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: dialog title

dup.description.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: dialog description

dup.scanPrompt.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: text before scanning
dup.scanPrompt.context: {count} is the number of charts in the library.

dup.scanButton.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: button that starts the scan

dup.noneFound.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: result when nothing looks duplicated

dup.clean.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: friendly line under the no-duplicates result

dup.groupHeading.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: heading of one group of similar charts
dup.groupHeading.context: {number} is the group's position (1, 2, …); {percent} is a whole-number similarity percentage.

dup.groupSize.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: number of charts in one group
dup.groupSize.context: {count} is the number of charts in the group.

dup.archivedToast.where: Library > Duplicate Scanner dialog: success toast after archiving
dup.archivedToast.context: {count} is the number of duplicate charts archived.
